statements.t: We do not expect significant increases in revenue from these sources in future quarters.

Management expects the sales and marketing expenses to significantly decline, quarter over quarter for the remainder of the year as less marketing expenses are spent on the remaining products and several of the fixed sales and marketing expenses have been eliminated.
Excluding legal expenses, management expects general and administrative expenses in subsequent quarters to remain relatively consistent with first quarter levels.
Management also expects legal expenses to remain elevated through March 31, 2027, then decline and stabilize at less than $250,000 per quarter.

Management expects this reduction to lower annual interest expense by approximately $2.3 million, based on the $57.3 million outstanding as of September 30, 2026, assuming the outstanding principal balance and interest rate remain unchanged.
Various costs were incurred in connection with beginning, implementing, and growing the Company’s digital asset strategy and are expected to continue.
The locked Solana is unlocked through a schedule that will continue through January of 2028 and once unlocked is the same as any other liquid Solana in the Company’s treasury.

We estimate that we will have sufficient working capital to fund our operations over the twelve months following the date of the issuance of these condensed consolidated financial statements and meet all of our debt obligations.
